import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { changesets } from "./changesets";
import { redactions } from "./redactions";

export const nodes = defineTable("nodes", {
    columns: {
        nodeId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        latitude: col.integer().notNull(),
        longitude: col.integer().notNull(),
        changesetId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        visible: col.boolean().notNull(),
        timestamp: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        tile: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        version: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        redactionId: col.integer()
    },
    relations: {
        changeset: rel.belongsTo(() => changesets, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        redaction: rel.belongsTo(() => redactions, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
